text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити is full of energy as she
prepares for the
Japanese Derby, and
her training is going well.
How was that, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You beat your record time! Congrats!

text_block_list.text: Yes!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Not to flatter myself, but I'm in peak
form, aren't
I?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
If I become a Derby champion... that'll
make you
a Derby trainer.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: What, you don't think it suits me?

text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I meant. And, well,
we
shouldn't get too ahead of ourselves.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's just, it still doesn't feel real that I'm
going to
be competing in the Derby.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I knew I wanted to run, but I didn't really
have
specific races I wanted to compete
in.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Looking back, I just had this vague
notion that I
wanted to win a bunch of
G1 races or whatever.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But now I'm running in the Derby. Like,
what?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Her spirits are high. I'm wondering how
we can
ride this wave all the way to the
Derby when...
Hey, City! ♪ I'm here. ☆
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Jordan? What, you here to bother me?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Why are you so mean?! Emotional
damage!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
You keep ignoring all my texts too.
Have you got
any idea how bored I've
been?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Why don't you do some training?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you and your work ethic. It's good
that
you're motivated, but don't get
injured!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: You know what happened to Tamamo.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Huh? What happened?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't know? It happened during
a race.
She got caught up in a rough
struggle.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I saw her running by the river not long
ago. She
looked bad—it was so hard to
watch.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
After training, we head down to the
riverbank to
check on Тамамо Кросс.
Pant, pant... Urgh!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Why can't my body just listen?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Are you okay?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: City...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Guess ya heard and wanted to see for
yourself?
Look at me, I'm a wreck...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: No, that's not—
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I know. It's no use. I'm just not
enough.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
If only I was stronger... this wouldn't
have
happened!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс is recovering from an
injury she
sustained during a race the
other day, when a
number of runners
clustered together and fell.

Seriously... I lack everything. Stamina,
strength, I
don't have anything I needta
win.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: But you...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's okay. It's the truth, and whining
won't do
anything about it. But ya know
what?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
If I don't have what it takes, I just gotta
snatch it
by force! I'm gonna keep
runnin' and runnin' till I
can win!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I don't need anything but victory! I'll
keep tryin'
even if it kills me!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I may be poor, and I may be short, but
so what?!
I'll force my way through with
my own two legs!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
So I don't need your sympathy. I'm not
gonna
lose, especially not to you.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Me?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I saw the Satsuki Sho. You surprised
everybody.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You already accomplished what ya set
out to do.
So, I gotta accomplish my
goal too: winning.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Time to keep trainin'. We both gotta
stand our
ground and give it our all!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: ...She's so strong.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She doesn't need anything but
victory,
huh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll have a chance if she
makes it to the
track.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I swear, you think enthusiasm can solve
all the
problems in the world.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Let's go back to training. I have more
faith in that
than I do in you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I have to show her I can win the Derby!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
